examples.solution_text:
Each triangle has an angle sum of $180^{\circ}$.

The two angles at $B$ combine to form $\angle ABC$, and the two at $D$ combine to form $\angle ADC$. Together, the six triangle angles make the four interior angles of the quadrilateral.

$\begin{aligned}\angle DAB+\angle ABC+\angle BCD+\angle ADC&=180^{\circ}+180^{\circ}\\&=360^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

The marked right angle is $90^{\circ}$. The four interior angles add to $360^{\circ}$.

$\begin{aligned}x+72+108+90&=360\\x+270&=360\\x&=90^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: A non-convex quadrilateral has interior angles of $238^{\circ}$, $32^{\circ}$, $41^{\circ}$ and $x$. Find $x$.
examples.solution_text:
Include the reflex interior angle $238^{\circ}$ in the angle sum.

$\begin{aligned}x+238+32+41&=360\\x+311&=360\\x&=49^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: The four interior angles of a quadrilateral are $(2x+10)^{\circ}$, $(3x-20)^{\circ}$, $(x+30)^{\circ}$ and $(2x+20)^{\circ}$. Find $x$.
examples.solution_text:
Add the four angle expressions and set their total equal to $360$.

$\begin{aligned}(2x+10)+(3x-20)+(x+30)+(2x+20)&=360\\8x+40&=360\\8x&=320\\x&=40\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: Three interior angles of a quadrilateral are $31^{\circ}$, $43^{\circ}$ and $54^{\circ}$. Find the fourth interior angle and explain why it is reflex.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{aligned}x+31+43+54&=360\\x+128&=360\\x&=232^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

Since $232^{\circ}>180^{\circ}$, the fourth interior angle is reflex.

examples.derivation: BD lies inside the depicted convex quadrilateral, forming triangles ABD and BCD. Their angles at B and D recombine into the quadrilateral's interior angles, so the total is 180° + 180° = 360°.
The square marks 90°. The known angles total 72° + 108° + 90° = 270°, leaving x = 360° − 270° = 90°. The explicitly not-to-scale diagram places the givens consistently.

The reflex interior angle is included directly: 238° + 32° + 41° = 311°, so x = 49°. These positive angles total 360° and are consistent with a non-convex quadrilateral. The worded task needs no diagram.

Collecting the four expressions gives 8x + 40 = 360, hence x = 40. Substitution gives angles 90°, 100°, 70° and 100°, totalling 360°. The task uses the supplied source's angle-sum and inverse-operations method without requiring its supplementary parallelogram proof.

31° + 43° + 54° = 128°, so the remaining interior angle is 360° − 128° = 232°. Since 232° exceeds 180°, it is reflex. This reverses the source-supported known-reflex task without introducing a new method.
